title: Dedicated capacity weekly prep — 1:1 + sync notes (MB)
content:
Notes to self / prep for this week's dedicated capacity 1:1 + weekly sync

Context summary:
- Running tighter on A100-80GB pool due to two new large prod reservations (Large-Enterprise-1 + FinApp-B). Current commit: 40 A100-80GB reserved across two clusters, expected peak usage during business hours.
- Forecast shows highest daily 95th percentile token throughput in March/April due to onboarding schedule.
- Autoscaler config currently uses target_util=0.7, cooldown=300s, max_burst=12 GPUs. Need to validate thresholds after the reservation ramp.

Agenda (1:1 with Priya, 30m)
- Quick status check on outstanding action items from last week (5m)
- Reservation reconciliation: confirm start/end dates for Large-Enterprise-1 (starts 2026-03-01, 3-mo commit) and FinApp-B (starts 2026-03-15, 6-mo) (10m)
- Autoscaler tuning proposal (see below): discuss switching to percentile-based scale-up trigger for sudden spikes (10m)
- Blockers / support needs: SRE capacity for cross-region failover tests (5m)

Agenda (weekly team sync, 45m)
- Roll call + quick wins (5m)
- Current pool utilization & forecast review (10m)
- Autoscaling incidents since last sync (5m)
- Reservation queue & upcoming customer commits (10m)
- Ops playbook updates: runbook changes for reservation over-provisioning and day-0 bootstrapping (10m)
- AOB / action items (5m)

Current numbers (quick snapshot) — last 24h aggregate:
- A100-80GB pool: 38/40 reserved in use on average (peak 92% utilization), 2 GPUs idle (but fragmentation across clusters)
- A100-40GB pool: 10/16 reserved in use (avg 62%)
- A10G pool: 14/24 (avg 58%)
- Pending reservations: Large-Enterprise-1: +8 A100-80GB (2026-03-01 to 2026-05-31), FinApp-B: +6 A100-80GB (2026-03-15 to 2026-09-14)

Forecast assumptions:
- Onboarding velocity: we expect daily token volume to increase ~18% week-over-week for March due to integrations finishing.
- Model mix: 60% high-memory LLMs (A100-80/40), 30% midrange A10G, 10% CPU/embedded workloads.
- Autoscaler reaction: currently triggers scale-up when avg_util over 3m > 0.7. Scaling latency ~120s for warmup + 180s for provisioning in cloud provider.

Risks / open questions:
- Fragmentation: we have pockets of underutilized GPUs in region-eu-west-1 cluster-3. Could rebalancing help vs risk of disrupting active reservations?
- Burst capacity: current max_burst=12 might not be enough if two large customers spike simultaneously during demo windows. Consider increasing to 20 for a short period with cost guardrails.
- Cross-region failover: we need a dry run scheduled before FinApp-B goes live (they require <200ms tail-latency SLAs).
- Pricing / customer expectations: verify that committed pricing for FinApp-B includes prioritized autoscaling and pre-warmed capacity (they asked for guaranteed 95th percentile).

Autoscaler tuning notes (proposal)
- Move to hybrid trigger: scale-up on 95th-percentile CPU/GPU util > 0.75 over 2m OR sustained avg_util > 0.72 over 5m. Rationale: reduce false positives from transient bursts while catching sustained pressure.
- Add a short-term fast-burst policy: when we see queued requests > threshold (configurable), trigger a fast warmup path that reserves ephemeral burst GPUs (up to +10) with higher cost flag. Only allowed for customers with burst add-on.
- Backoff adjustments: reduce cool-down to 180s after manual override to allow quicker contraction when demand subsides.

Action items (who / by when)
- Priya: confirm exact start/end dates + billing terms with Sales for FinApp-B (due 2026-03-04)
- Ava: run fragmentation analysis for eu-west-1 cluster-3 and propose a non-disruptive rebalancing plan (due 2026-03-06)
- Liam: schedule cross-region failover dry run and coordinate with SRE & FinApp-B (target window 2026-03-10 to 03-12)
- MB (me): update autoscaler config in staging and run load test to validate the hybrid trigger (due 2026-03-05). Document test steps in linked GitHub runbook.
- MB: follow up with Finance on budget delta if we increase max_burst to 20 for a temporary window (due 2026-03-06)

Notes to include in sync slides (short bullets)
- Utilization snapshot + 2-week forecast chart (png from dashboard)
- Pending reservations & start dates (table)
- Proposed autoscaler changes (call out fast-burst option)
- Risks: fragmentation + cross-region failover readiness

Quick reference links (for the meeting)
- Capacity dashboard: https://console.internal.redwood/capacity/dedicated
- Runbook (draft): https://confluence.internal.redwood/dedicated-capacity-runbook
- JIRA ticket: DED-4321 (reservation reconciliation)

Loose thoughts / scratch (brain dump)
- Could offer a short-term "pre-warm" SKU for customers who want demo-level guarantees; priced as a 1.2x multiplier on committed rate. Makes it easier to sell guaranteed tails.
- Consider a nightly rebalancer that packs low-util VMs to free up whole GPUs for reservations instead of spreading load. Risk: slight bump in transient latency during migrations, need SRE signoff.
- Need a postmortem template for reservation misses (similar to incident PM).

End of notes.

-- MB
